locator: A4C, causal steps 1–4 and note 1 after step 17
interpretation: The author opens a reductio, then classifies the possible caused thing as contingent under that supposition. Record this asserted conditional step, not an established no-Necessary-Being premise. If the caused-thing domain includes non-cause-capable or otherwise unclassified bearers, the classification does not follow merely from impossibility of the source’s cause-capable Necessary Being. Do not fix that gap by silently strengthening P1 or assuming all caused things concrete. Note1 permits bearer talk without requiring abstract properties as causal objects.
